title: Comfort Club Member Discount on Line-Set Change Orders for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Member change-order discount

**Rule.** The member change-order discount on a line-set change order of a Replacement System Installations project follows the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement, as held in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records:

- an agreement in active status whose consecutive terms are at least 5 takes the tier's accessory discount percentage plus 5 percentage points off the line-set change order;
- an agreement in active status whose consecutive terms are fewer than 5 takes the tier's accessory discount percentage;
- a homeowner with no agreement in active status takes no member change-order discount.

The tier's accessory discount percentage is the member accessory discount of the Comfort Club tier the agreement is on.

## Input — judgement — output

| Agreement status | Consecutive terms | Member change-order discount |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 5 or more | Tier's accessory discount percentage plus 5 points |
| Active | Fewer than 5 | Tier's accessory discount percentage |
| Pending, past due, lapsed, cancelled, or no agreement | Any | None |

## Cases (hypothetical members; tier percentages chosen for illustration)

- An active agreement on a tier with a 10 percent accessory discount, in its 6th consecutive term: 10 plus 5, a 15 percent discount.
- The same tier in exactly its 5th consecutive term: 15 percent — 5 terms meets "at least 5".
- The same tier in its 4th consecutive term: 10 percent.
- A lapsed agreement in its 8th term: no discount, because the agreement is not in active status.
